title: How do I get a link code?

steps.title: Sign in to the Zermelo Portal
steps.text: Go to your school's portal, for example **jfc.zportal.nl**, and sign in as you always do.

steps.title: Open Koppel externe applicatie
steps.text: Go to **Instellingen → Koppel externe applicatie** (Settings → Link external application). You now see a 12-digit link code.

steps.title: Take a screenshot
steps.text: You cannot copy the link code. So press **Print Screen** (prnt scrn) while the code is on screen.

steps.title: Copy the code from the screenshot
steps.text: In the screenshot toolbar, click the **AI text button** (text actions). Select the link code and copy it.

steps.title: Paste it here
steps.text: Fill in your school above, paste the code under **Link code** and choose **Link**. A link code works once and only for a short while, so do this right away.
